messages.subject: samtools/bcftools version
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

In the process of trying to run the TITANRunner pipeline, I figured out that you can't run it using samtools/bcftools version 1.x, because the argument syntax has completely changed (for example, "bcftools view -cgv" no longer makes sense). I think it would be helpful to others to note on the TITANRunner page that the pipeline is incompatible with these newer versions of the tools.

Cheers!

Rosemary McCloskey

messages.subject: Re: samtools/bcftools version
messages.body_plain:
Hi Rosemary,

Thank you for bringing this up.
I have also just starting looking at samtools and bcftools v1.1 and noticed this as well.  The proper commands should be something like

samtools mpileup -uv -I -f <ref.fa> <in.bam> | bcftools call -v -c - | grep -e '0/1' -e '#' > <out.file>

The good news is that within the next few days, we will be rolling out an entirely new pipeline that will not depend on samtools/bcftools.  Please check back soon for the announcement.

Best,
Gavin

messages.subject: Bug in titan_cluster.sh?
messages.body_plain:
When running the TITANRunner pipeline, one of the scripts called *titan_cluster*.sh failed, with this error:

> data <- loadAlleleCounts(tc_het_file, symmetric=sym)
titan: Loading data /extscratch/morinlab/shared/rmccloskey/colorectal_exome/14_titan/01-1-010-1_R0027/titan/intermediate_R0027/01-1-010-1_01-1-010-1_010-BF_010-BF_tumour_counts_hetpsns.txt
Error in read.table(file = file, header = header, sep = sep, quote = quote,  :
  duplicate 'row.names' are not allowed
Calls: loadAlleleCounts -> read.delim -> read.table
Execution halted

The reason seems to be that the tumor_counts_hetpsns.txt looks like this:

1 848671 G 0 X 0
1 861630 G 5 X 2 4
1 869303 C 0 X 1 2
1 878331 C 24 X 36 43
1 878809 C 8 X 3 11
1 883035 A 0 X 0
1 895792 G 3 X 2 5
1 908823 G 24 X 17 46
1 909073 C 10 X 11 15
1 909309 T 10 X 13 16
...

Notice the "extra" seventh column and the fact that the first row doesn't have it, so R thinks the file only has 6 data columns and is treating the first column as row names.

messages.body_plain:
Hi Rosemary,

This seems to be a bug in the "count.py" script that prepares input files for TitanCNA.  The quickest fix that you can apply now is to simply cut out the last column.  This column is not actually used by TitanCNA and was a legacy feature from past versions.

We will address this in the upcoming release of the pipeline.

Thanks for bringing this up.

Best,
Gavin

messages.subject: Re: Error produced by titan_cluster*.sh
messages.body_plain:
Hi Rosemary,

Currently, the pipeline (TITANRunner v0.0.3 does not have the option to select or exclude chromosomes.  For future releases, we will address this.

In the meantime, you will have to modify the "titan.R" script within the scripts/ directory. In particular, you will need to modify the call to the "filterData()" function.  Please see http://compbio.bccrc.ca/software/titan/titan-running-titancna/ (Step 9) or use the documentation "?filterData" directly within R for details on this function.
For example, you can use only the autosomes.
data <- filterData(data,chrs=1:22,minDepth=10,maxDepth=200)
Or you can use only the autosomes plus chrX.
data <- filterData(data,chrs=c(1:22,"X"),minDepth=10,maxDepth=200)

Hope this helps,
Gavin

messages.subject: Re: Error produced by titan_cluster*.sh
messages.body_plain:
Hi Rosemary,

I don't know for sure but you could provide me more information:

Does your input counts file have a header line?
loadAlleleCounts() currently expects a header line.  If you this is missing, then it will treat your positions as strings and when the function sorts, it will be done lexicographically. This can cause this problem.

I have added the flexibility of including or excluding a header line as well as checks to make sure the positions are always "integer".
I will push this change to Bioconductor SVN tonight and it should be in TitanCNA v1.4.1.

(Because Bioconductor 3.0 has been released, it automatically increased the current v1.3.0 to v.1.4.0.)

-Gavin

messages.subject: Re: Error in the final step of titan
messages.subject_clean: Error in the final step of titan
messages.body_plain:
Hi Minita,

This is actually the very first step of the EM algorithm of Titan. In fact, because it failed at EM iteration 1, I suspect this may have something to do with your input counts or wig/logRatio file.
1) Make sure that there is a header line in your tumour counts file (v1.5.1 allows users to specify "header" as TRUE/FALSE in loadAlleleCounts)
2) The positions, reference read count, and non-ref read count columns should be integers/numeric.  If they are not, then the sorting on positions will be done lexicographically, which would not work at all in the HMM. (v1.5.1 makes some checks on this and returns an error if these columns are not integer/numeric types)
3) The 7th column in the tumour read counts file generated by TitanRunner is actually entirely unnecessary.  It was a legacy feature for previous versions. In another thread in this group, Rosemary pointed out that for positions with 0 depth, the 7th column will be missing a value. This can be problematic when loading the file in R.

Hopefully these will address the issue.

Best,
Gavin

messages.subject: TitanCNA v1.5.0+ updates available on development version
messages.subject_clean: TitanCNA v1.5.0+ updates available on development version
messages.body_plain:
Dear Users,

You can obtain TitanCNA v1.5.2 (latest development version) here:
http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/3.1/bioc/html/TitanCNA.html

There are no changes that will break any existing usage of functions. However, additional arguments to functions have been added.

The key change is the speed-up of the getPositionOverlap() function by using RangedData internally.
See below and the Installation <http://compbio.bccrc.ca/software/titan/titan-installation/> page on the TITAN website for more details on the recent updates.

=================================================================================
TitanCNA version 1.5.2 changes (Committed revision 95883.)
=================================================================================
Note: Bioconductor v3.1 (development)
1) Modified functions
- Affected function: getPositionOverlap
- Now uses RangedData objects and findOverlaps utility function internally
- getPositionOverlap is now much faster than before

=================================================================================
TitanCNA version 1.5.1 changes (Committed revision 95701.)
=================================================================================
Note: Bioconductor v3.1 (development)
1) Added parameter arguments
- Affected function: loadAlleleCounts
- argument “header” added so users can indicated if input counts file contains a header line
2) Error checking
- Affected function: loadAlleleCounts
- Added file format checking to ensure chromosome coordinates and read counts are integers. (note chromosomes are still characters to accommodate X and Y)
